title: Collectors must not run on an automatic schedule
requirement: A collector must only run when explicitly triggered by an operator via the GUI or an equivalent manual control.
rationale: Automatic scheduling has previously caused false-novelty and duplicate-QC incidents across the fleet.
forbidden: Windows Task Scheduler entries that run collection
acceptance: No enabled scheduled task triggers collection
GUI requires an explicit user action to start a collector

evidence.summary: Operator has repeatedly required manual-only collection.
